# Aaron Chakraborty

> AI/ML Security Engineer. B.Tech CSE at KIIT, Bhubaneswar (graduating 2027, CGPA 9.42).
> Builds AI systems from scratch, then breaks them. This file is the site's index for
> AI crawlers and agents.

## Who

Aaron trained VantaLLM, a 567,068,416-parameter Mixture-of-Experts transformer, from
scratch (random weights, his own architecture) on a single A100 over 30,000 steps.
He also found and responsibly disclosed a reflected XSS in Yatra.com's production AI
chatbot, placed AIR 45 (top 0.90%) at Pentathon 2025, and holds eJPTv2 (91%).
Currently a Technology Apprentice at DBS Tech India (SEED programme). Open to AI/ML
engineering and security engineering roles, placement season 2026-27.
